featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.

today.description:
# 🚛 🎗️ **TCCR Pink Convoy: A Journey for Her**  



## 🎗️ ABOUT THE EVENT  

This is not just a convoy.  

This October, TCCR invites you to be part of something meaningful —  
**“Pink Convoy: A Journey for Her”**  

A charity event dedicated to the fight against breast cancer,  
and a personal tribute that makes this convoy truly special.
  
This event is held **in honor of a mother** —  
a symbol of strength, love, and resilience.  

Through her story, we stand with every woman  
who has faced, is facing, or will face this battle.
  
💖 Together, we drive with purpose.  

---

## 💰 CHARITY & DONATIONS  

We are raising funds to support the fight against breast cancer.  

🎗️ **How to support:**  
  
* Donate through our official campaign link  https://www.goodcrowd.org/c/baf0jTCR   
* Share the event  
* Join the convoy and be part of the message  

All contributions help bring awareness and support to this cause.  

---

## 🎀 DONATION LEVELS  

💖 **$5 — In Memory**  
🌸 **$10 — Supporter**  
🎗️ **$25 — Pink Warrior**  
👑 **$50 — Legacy**  

Every contribution matters. Every name becomes part of this journey.  


## 🤝 PARTNERS & VTCs  

We welcome all VTCs and communities to be part of this cause.  

If your VTC would like to participate or collaborate,  
feel free to contact us.  

💖 Let’s make this convoy a united effort.  

---

---

## 📌 EVENT INFORMATION  

**📅 Date:** Sunday , October 18, 2026  
**🕒 Meetup Time:** 18:30 UTC  
**🚚 Departure Time:** 19:30 UTC 

**📍 Start Location:** Calais  (Slots)   
**🏁 Destination:** Hamburg (IA Automotive)   
  
**🌍 DLC Required:** none  
**🖥️ Server:** Event Server   

---

## 📸 MEDIA & COVERAGE  

* Official screenshots will be taken  
* Recap will be published after the event  
* Streaming is highly encouraged  


This convoy is more than a route.  

It is a tribute.  
A memory.  
A message of hope.  

🎗️ Join us. Drive with us.  
Drive for her.

today.name: CONVOY DECEPTICONS TRANSPORTANDO CHATARRA  VALIOSA A MEGATRON
today.description:
El sol de Texas caía con una fuerza implacable sobre el asfalto de la Interestatal 10, pero para el convoy Decepticon, el calor era lo de menos. Los motores modificados de los imponentes camiones pesados rugían en una frecuencia baja y amenazante mientras dejaban atrás los áridos paisajes de Van Horn. Su cargamento no era mercancía ordinaria: transportaban toneladas de chatarra valiosa, restos de tecnología cibertroniana y aleaciones militares de alto secreto recuperadas de una base clandestina en el desierto. Una ofrenda directa para el mismísimo Megatron.
La orden del líder supremo había sido categórica: «Traigan esos componentes intactos. Quien falle en asegurar la carga conocerá mi cañón de fusión».
A la cabeza del convoy, el comandante de la ruta vigilaba los sistemas de radar encriptados a través de TruckersMP. El viaje a través del estado de la estrella solitaria era largo y peligroso; debían cruzar cientos de kilómetros vigilados por las fuerzas de seguridad humanas y, potencialmente, por exploradores Autobot.
—Mantengan la formación en US Simulation y no bajen de las 70 millas por hora —ordenó el líder del convoy por la radio—. Cerca de San Antonio aumentaremos la seguridad. Megatron espera este metal en la costa.
Los camiones devoraban el asfalto de Texas, pasando de los terrenos montañosos del oeste a las llanuras centrales. Las pesadas plataformas, reforzadas con energía oscura, brillaban con un tenue destello morado bajo las luces de los tableros digitales. Cada contenedor iba sellado magnéticamente para ocultar la firma de energía cibertroniana.
Finalmente, tras horas de tensa navegación y esquivar las patrullas fronterizas, el horizonte plano del golfo comenzó a asomarse. El convoy redujo la velocidad al entrar en los sectores industriales de Victoria, Texas, donde los agentes de tierra ya tenían preparado el búnker de descarga. Las compuertas se abrieron para recibir las toneladas de metal que servirían para forjar el nuevo armamento del ejército Decepticon. La misión en Texas había sido un éxito rotundo.

Welcome to Cancer awareness event!


* **Event Server Opens at 11am BST
* People arrive 11.30am BST

* Event server closes 9pm BST**

We are back again for another year of Cancer Awareness! [Charity Discord Server](https://discord.gg/uyAPcu9kUm)



I know cancer can be really tough to fight and it's close to people's family so I went on and decided why not do my own cancer event to raise money for cancer

This is really close to me so I would like to see as many people as we can get there and show some support!

what is cancer?

Cancer is a group of diseases involving abnormal cell growth with the potential to invade or spread to other parts of the body. These contrast with benign tumors, which do not spread With more cancer research funding, Congress can help save more lives. Every major cancer breakthrough in the past 50 years can be traced back to federally funded research. More funding for cancer research means new lifesaving treatments, new ways to prevent the disease, and more lives saved.

Cancer Awareness Campaigns get people talking about cancer, reduces the stigma of the disease, and increases support for those suffering from cancer. Putting a face to cancer can help people understand the reality of a cancer diagnosis and bring home the importance of prevention in reducing each person’s overall risk.

Together we can beat cancer.

# PL:  
Drodzy kierowcy,  
    
Z okazji 9 lat istnienia Coffee-Spedition mamy zaszczyt zaprosić Was na nasz konwój urodzinowy. Minione lata były wyjątkowe, więc przeżyjmy tamte dobre chwile po raz kolejny.  
  
## Jak dołączyć do wydarzenia?  
Jeśli jesteś członkiem VTC i chciałbyś dołączyć ze swoją firmą, proszę otwórz ticket na naszym discordzie. Tam przekażemy Ci wszelkie informacje, oraz wyznaczymy miejsce, z którego Twoja firma będzie startować.  

Jeśli nie jesteś zrzeszony w VTC, lub chciałbyś pojawić się osobiście to poprostu wejdź na serwer w dniu wydarzenia i zajmij slot publiczny  
## Szczegóły wydarzenia:  
Data: 24 października 2026  
Godzina zbiórki: 19:00  
Godzina wyjazdu: 20:00  
Start: Frankfurt nad Menem (sloty)  
Miejsce docelowe: Antwerpia (Port kontenerowy)  
Komunikacja głosowa z innymi uczestnikami wydarzenia będzie odbywać się na discordzie Coffee-Spediton: https://discord.gg/c2EQMtpnd6  
### Dodatkowe informacje:  
- Na końcu wydarzenia każdy uczestnik zostanie poproszony o porzucenie/odstawienie naczepy i ustawienie się w miejscu docelowym samym ciągnikiem.  
# EN:  
Dear Virtual Truckers,  

Coffee-Spedition is celebrating its 9th anniversary. It was a great period of time for us and we'd like to invite you to our special convoy.  

## How to join our event?  
If you're a member of a VTC and would like to join with your company, please head to our discord and contact us using the ticket system. We'll provide you with all the necessary information and assign your company a starting slot.  
If you are not a member of a VTC or would like to join personally, simply join our server on the day of the event and take a public slot.  
## Event details: 
Date: 24 October 2026  
Meetup Time: 7:00 PM  
Departure Time: 8:00 PM  
Start: Frankfurt am Main (slots)   
Destination: Antwerp (Container port)  
Voice communication with other truckers and event staff will take place on Coffee-Spediton's discord server: https://discord.gg/c2EQMtpnd6 (main communication language is polish)  
### Additional information:  
- At the end of the event, each participant will be asked to dismiss/leave their trailer and line up at the destination with their truck only.

upcoming.name: GAAT GROUP - ROAD TO HALLOWEEN
upcoming.rule:
📜 Temporary Rules

🔹 Event Rules for Participants:
- Only approved Event Staff are permitted to use the following tags in their player name: "GAAT | EM", "GAAT | ES", "GAAT | ET", "GAAT | Lead", "GAAT | Co-Lead", "GAAT | CC", "GAAT | Tail", "GAAT | MM", "GAAT | Media" or similar.
- Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.
- Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
- Participants must haul a trailer and dismiss it at the end location. (Except Event Staff)
- Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Cars are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.
- Overtaking is prohibited.
- Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
- Participants of the convoy must ignore traffic lights unless it is unsafe to do so.
- Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
- Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
- Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.

🔹 Event Rules for Event Staff:
- Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
- Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.
